title: An only child, one cousin, and lifelong Milwaukee friends
summary: Herman was an only child; his one cousin, a history professor, died young, and he stays close to boyhood friends in Milwaukee.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I see. So did you have cousins that you related to? I was wondering if any peer age relationships --
I had one cousin on my father's side, and -- who died a few years ago, at quite an early age, actually. He was in his early '30s.
And he was -- he had his doctorate, in a little religious college in Iowa. And taught history, American history.
So there's -- do you have any connections or relations that you maintained at all with your --
I don't have any relations at this point that I keep in contact with at all, because my Dad's side of the family is all gone.
My mother's side is in many different areas, and we've not kept that close. But I have some very tight and close friends in the Milwaukee area.
Guys that I was raised with, and who are more like brothers than friends.
I see. These were people from your boy-hood on?
People who were -- we were all raised together, and our mothers were very close. Our fathers were close.
